_comment: Declarative configuration for .cursor/hooks/guard_write_scope.py. Editing this file changes what the guard refuses. Keep it the single place where protected surfaces are named, so a boundary is never restated in prose in two places that can drift apart.

refused_commands.reason: Pull-request writes are not a lane capability. In this estate a PR is a projection, never an acceptance, and lanes return branches rather than opening or moving pull requests.

This route's GitHub credential is read-only for everything except git contents. A write attempt here fails at GitHub anyway; refusing locally makes the boundary explicit instead of producing a confusing 403.
Force push destroys the immutable-SHA custody the whole evidence ladder depends on. Use --force-with-lease only after an explicit instruction.
History rewriting breaks byte-for-byte read-back by immutable SHA, which is the property that makes produced evidence independently checkable.
